source_title: Save $60 on Eufy’s dual-lens SoloCam S340 security camera
source_excerpt:

The Eufy Security SoloCam S340 is built for people who want a better view of what’s happening outside their home, and it’s on sale right now on Amazon. This wire-free outdoor security camera packs more than the usual basics, with a dual-lens setup that combines a 3K wide-angle view with a telephoto lens for closer detail.
That setup helps the SoloCam S340 cover more ground while still letting you zoom in on what matters. It offers 360-degree pan and tilt coverage, up to 8x hybrid zoom, and person and vehicle tracking that can follow activity around a yard or driveway. You also get two-way talk, spotlight and night vision, motion alerts, and app-based live view, so it’s designed to keep you in the loop whether you’re home or away.
One of the big draws here is that it’s made to be low-maintenance. The removable solar panel is meant to help keep the camera powered with daily sun, and footage can be stored locally. Eufy also markets it with no required monthly fee, and it works on its own without needing a base station, which keeps the setup more straightforward.
The deal is what makes this a good time to pick one up. The Eufy Security SoloCam S340 has dropped to $139.98 on Amazon, down from its $199.99 recommended retail price. That’s a 30% discount off the RRP, which saves you $60.
